input_sources: new_party_generator output; party_state; party_places; party_locations; world_base.graph_nodes; novgorod_g5_scene_templates_v1
validation_gates: party_id, character_id, region_id, place_id, location_id, canonical_g4_node_id/g4_type_id, season, time, weather, start cause are present; no G1-G4 creation here.
repair_on_fail: Return missing or inconsistent context to new-party generator; do not create fallback location in code.
hidden_allowed: yes, for already approved hidden start state only
notes: This step freezes the target G4; all G5 nodes must be children of it.

validation_gates: Exact g4_type_id match preferred; category fallback requires needs_review issue; allowed/required/forbidden anchor lists copied from template, not invented.
repair_on_fail: Ask LLM/template editor for matching G4 template; do not use generic scene anchors if no template exists.
notes: Template is a limit and causal frame, not a precreated G5 map.

input_sources: party_minilocations; party_scene_anchors; party_items; party_npcs; party_graph_nodes; party_graph_edges
validation_gates: Existing facts cannot be silently overwritten; duplicate anchor/item/NPC risks identified before drafting new G5.
repair_on_fail: Return to LLM with locked facts and require reuse/update rather than duplicate materialization.
notes: Needed for returning to an existing scene or resuming after partial start generation.

input_sources: G5StartInputContext; G5TemplateMatch; G5ExistingStateSnapshot; time/season/weather; place function; PC status
validation_gates: At least one minilocation and one primary scene anchor; all anchors inside selected G4; no forbidden anchor types; required anchor categories covered; generation limits observed.
repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to rebuild anchors within allowed template lists and explicit causal basis.
hidden_allowed: yes, but split visible/hidden fields in contract
notes: This is the main semantic materialization step. Code must not choose anchors.

input_sources: G5SceneGraphDraft; item/property rules; NPC presence; light/weather/status/time
validation_gates: Each significant anchor has visibility, access, owner/controller/holder when relevant, witnesses and risk; hidden facts have visible signs only when justified.
repair_on_fail: Return anchors without owner/access/risk/visibility to LLM for completion; remove ungrounded hidden objects.
player_visible: no; only filtered visible package later
notes: Prevents empty anchors and unfair hidden objects.

human_stage: Привязка предметов и людей к G5
input_sources: G5AnchorAccessVisibilityPackage; item profiles; container profiles; NPC profile rules; existing party state
validation_gates: Items and NPCs are attached to anchor/minilocation with materialization reason; significant items have placement/owner/holder/access/risk; NPC depth matches memory need.
repair_on_fail: Require materialization reason or drop item/NPC from start scene; do not create inventory/object from player wish alone.
notes: Binding may update existing NPC/item rows or create party-level rows when LLM approves them.

input_sources: G5SceneGraphDraft; G5ObjectNpcBinding; graph_scale_rules G5; selected G4 location access
validation_gates: Each edge connects two G5 nodes in same selected G4; base_time_minutes is 0-5; access/risk/visibility conditions are explicit; reverse edge specified when movement is reversible.
repair_on_fail: Return impossible or out-of-range edges to LLM; no code-side edge guessing.
notes: G5 edges handle seconds/minutes, doors, thresholds, short approach, hiding places and witness line-of-sight.

validation_gates: selected anchor exists; position_visible_text is consistent; full region/place/location/minilocation/anchor/current_node chain can be written.
repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to choose a valid existing draft anchor or rebuild G5 graph.
notes: This produces the first actionable physical position of the player character.

input_sources: All G5 draft/audit contracts; PC knowledge; UI rules; hidden state
validation_gates: No hidden motives, hidden objects, future events, exact internal calculations or full objective map leak into player-facing package.
repair_on_fail: Return leak list to visibility selector; strip or convert hidden facts to visible signs only.
hidden_allowed: yes, only to exclude it from output
player_visible: yes after prose writer uses only this package
notes: This is the only G5 package allowed to reach intro prose.

input_sources: All prior contracts; party schema; repair/audit pipeline rules
validation_gates: No blocking issues: FK plan complete; no G1-G4 runtime creation; no template violation; no visibility leak; no missing required fields.
repair_on_fail: Block commit and send focused repair prompt to the failing agent.

writes_to_party_tables: party_graph_nodes; party_graph_edges; party_minilocations; party_scene_anchors; party_items; party_npcs; party_current_position; party_map_knowledge; party_llm_steps
validation_gates: Atomic transaction; all FK targets exist; no partial visible scene without current_position; failed commit rolls back and records validation issue.
repair_on_fail: Rollback; return SQL/FK/constraint issue to LLM or schema implementer depending on cause.
player_visible: no; next stage prose uses G5VisibleStartPackage
notes: The commit code writes only accepted plan; it does not invent missing fields.
